scope.boundary: COL26.8 has no exact Euglenozoa or Euglenophycota hierarchy root and ITIS has no Euglenozoa entry. The only reproducible ITIS scope is valid Euglenophycota TSN 9601; this is an ITIS-only partition, not a crosswalk for all Euglenozoa or a proxy for every Protists/Chromists species.

normalization: Remove the exact trailing COL authorship field from COL scientificName when that suffix is present; no authorship parser is used.
Normalize Unicode to NFC, replace underscores with spaces, collapse Unicode whitespace and trim.
For species-rank comparison, remove one parenthesized subgenus token in the exact Genus (Subgenus) species representation; genus and specific epithet must remain unchanged.
Preserve case, diacritics, punctuation and all remaining name tokens.

statuses.accepted: Unavailable: no exact COL root defines an eligible crosswalk.
statuses.synonym-current-name-redirect: Unavailable: no exact COL root defines an eligible crosswalk.
statuses.ambiguous: Unavailable: no exact COL root defines an eligible crosswalk.
statuses.unmatched: Unavailable: no exact COL root defines an eligible crosswalk.

exactMatching.prohibited: No fuzzy, edit-distance, phonetic, case-folded, diacritic-stripped, token-reordered, taxon-substituted or package-wide name matching is used.

evidenceBoundary.en: This CC0 ITIS-only partition is a frozen identifier/status record for the explicitly bounded Euglenophycota export. It is not a global Euglenozoa checklist, a COL crosswalk, final classification authority, phylogeny, species-concept equivalence assertion, biological dossier or scientific-review record.
evidenceBoundary.zh: 此 CC0 ITIS-only 分区是对明确限定的 Euglenophycota 导出的冻结标识/状态记录；它不是全球 Euglenozoa 名录、COL 交叉映射、最终分类权威、系统发育、物种概念等同性声明、生物档案或科学审查记录。

colUsageIdLocator.stableAddressing: No COL row shards exist because no exact COL root defines an eligible scope.

upstreamOnly.stableAddressing: No COL usage ID is assigned. Every current ITIS Euglenophycota species is in one immutable JSONL gzip shard.

web-light.statement: GitHub Pages carries the descriptor and hashes but no ITIS Euglenophycota row shard.

native-full.statement: Android and iOS include the complete ITIS-only partition byte-for-byte.
